references.text: Describes how the chief priests and elders gathered to plot to have Jesus condemned to death, parallel to Mark 14:55 where the chief priests and the whole council seek false testimony against Jesus to condemn him to death.
Refers to how the chief priests and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus in order to condemn him to death, which mirrors the event in Mark 14:55.
Tells of when the council, consisting of the chief priests and scribes, gathered to find a charge against Jesus, similar to the situation in Mark 14:55 where they seek testimony against him.
Describes how the high priest asks Jesus about his disciples and teaching, which can be seen in connection with Mark 14:55 where the chief priests and the council seek charges against Jesus.
